description: BroadcastChannel as Node 22's, within one program: channels of one name get each other's messages (a structured clone, a MessageEvent, on a later turn, in the order they were made), never their own, another name's never; onmessage and addEventListener; close() (posting after it is InvalidStateError), the missing-argument and DataCloneError errors, inspect, worker_threads.BroadcastChannel is the global; an open channel keeps the program alive until close() or unref(). Needs slicc-kernel 1.92.0's writable slot
